reproduction.determinism: The analysis stage is deterministic given the raw evidence (bootstrap seed 36306528608, 10000 resamples). The measurement stages are NOT deterministic in principle, because they read the live Web: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random resolves to a different article per visit, and several candidate roots redirect off-host. The reproducibility pass shows that within one session the screen verdicts and object counts were exactly stable for all 6 object-yielding sites, but slow drift over weeks is not controlled.
reproduction.raw_evidence_is_sufficient_to_recompute: Every derived number in result.json#metrics is recomputable from raw/*.jsonl by an auditor using the frozen identifiers, without re-contacting any site.
reproduction.expected_wall_clock: about 90 s for the screen pass, about 25 s for the token probe, about 200 s for the reproducibility pass, about 5 s for analysis, dominated by the 0.35 s inter-request delay.
